takeaways.text: Data Cloud and AI annual recurring revenue passed $1B, up more than 120% YoY. Salesforce had closed over 8,000 Agentforce deals since launch, half of them paid.
takeaways.title: AI revenue passed $1B

takeaways.text: Current remaining performance obligation — work customers have signed for and will pay for within a year — rose 12% to $29.6B. Future revenue is unusually visible.
takeaways.title: Backlog keeps climbing

takeaways.text: GAAP operating margin reached 19.8%, up from 18.7% a year ago, and operating cash flow hit $6.5B. During the quarter Salesforce also announced its agreement to acquire Informatica.
takeaways.title: Margins inched up

verdict: Salesforce grew revenue 8% to $9.8B as Data Cloud and AI recurring revenue passed $1B — up more than 120% — while net income held roughly flat at $1.54B as it spent to build out its Agentforce AI platform.
